title: Fantastic cruise
text: This sailboat cruise was the highlight of the entire vacation. Although the weather wasn’t that great our captain David was fantastic. Friendly, professional and very knowledgeable. Fiona who works in the office was also very friendly & helpful. Because other people cancelled last minute we were taken out early as we arrived early, and we really enjoyed having the boat to ourselves. We enjoyed cava, beer, snacks & were free to wander around the boat and sit wherever we like. I went upfront for a while & we sailed into the harbour & enjoyed looking at all the enormous yachts. I would recommend
author: Diane_H

title: Quick excursion after cruise
text: Wonderful and relaxing experience. There were plenty of drinks and snacks offered for the 2 hour excursion. Would have appreciated a little interaction about the history of Barcelona.
author: Michael_C

title: A really fun couple of hours on the water
text: I went with a group of friends and we all had great fun. The skipper was friendly, the tapas and drinks were lovely and a paddle board was provided for when we went swimming.
author: 172annabelg

title: The sail and swim...
text: The sail and swim experience was pleasant and relaxing way to the enjoy the Mediterranean Sea for the first time. Marcos was an excellent captain and made sure we had drinks topped up, took our photos, and offered us towels after our dip in the sea. He told us all about the coast of the city and provided interesting facts about the beach. A small plate of chips, manchego cheese, and ham were provided after we dried off which was a delicious treat to conclude our journey back to port. Would definitely recommend!
author: Renee_B

title: Perfect evening cruise
text: Wonderful sunset cruise, Captain was so much fun and extremely accommodating. Snacks and, enjoyed by all. We were also able to make a swim stop which everyone enjoyed.
author: MGTRaleighNC

title: A fantastic afternoon sailing in Barcelona!
text:
A fantastic afternoon sailing in Barcelona! The captain was friendly and welcoming, and the trip started right on time. He explained the plan and covered important safety information, including guidance for anyone interested in swimming.
We enjoyed cava and snacks, and the unlimited cava was exactly as advertised! The captain’s generous hospitality made the experience even better. A beautiful day on the water and a wonderful memory from my trip. Highly recommended! ⛵️🥂
author: Elena_D

title: Amazing
